parameters.text:
Привет! 👋 
Я бот для мониторинга маршруток.  
Я помогу вам автоматически отслеживать появление свободных мест на нужные рейсы "Атласа" и сразу пришлю уведомление, если кто-то сдаст билет.  
Выберите нужное действие в меню ниже 👇
Введите данные для отслеживания одним сообщением строго по шаблону: Откуда - Куда, ГГГГ-ММ-ДД, ЧЧ:ММ-ЧЧ:ММ  Пример: Минск - Гомель, 2026-11-05, 10:00-18:00

parameters.query:
SELECT 
    s.subscription_id, 
    TO_CHAR(s.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as date, 
    TO_CHAR(s.time_from, 'HH24:MI') as time_from, 
    TO_CHAR(s.time_to, 'HH24:MI') as time_to, 
    c1.name as dep_name, 
    c2.name as arr_name
FROM subscription s
JOIN "user" u ON s.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN city c1 ON s.departure_city_id = c1.city_id
JOIN city c2 ON s.arrival_city_id = c2.city_id
WHERE u.telegram_id = {{ $('Telegram Trigger').first().json.callback_query.message.chat.id }};

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO subscription (
    user_id,
    departure_city_id,
    arrival_city_id,
    date,
    time_from,
    time_to,
    status
)
VALUES (
    (SELECT user_id FROM "user" WHERE telegram_id = {{ $('Telegram Trigger').item.json.message.from.id }}),
    (SELECT city_id FROM city WHERE name = '{{ $('Parse Telegram Input').item.json.dep_name }}' LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT city_id FROM city WHERE name = '{{ $('Parse Telegram Input').item.json.arr_name }}' LIMIT 1),
    '{{ $('Parse Telegram Input').item.json.date }}'::date,
    '{{ $('Parse Telegram Input').item.json.time_from }}'::time,
    '{{ $('Parse Telegram Input').item.json.time_to }}'::time,
    'ACTIVE'
);

DELETE FROM subscription 
WHERE subscription_id = REPLACE('{{ $json.message.text }}', '/del', '')::integer
  AND user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM "user" WHERE telegram_id = {{ $('Telegram Trigger').first().json.message.chat.id }})
RETURNING subscription_id;

SELECT 
  (SELECT user_id FROM "user" WHERE telegram_id = {{ $json.telegram_id }} LIMIT 1) AS user_id,

  (SELECT city_id FROM city WHERE LOWER(TRIM(name)) = LOWER(TRIM('{{ $json.dep_name }}')) LIMIT 1) AS dep_city_id,
  (SELECT atlas_city_id FROM city WHERE LOWER(TRIM(name)) = LOWER(TRIM('{{ $json.dep_name }}')) LIMIT 1) AS dep_atlas_id,

  (SELECT city_id FROM city WHERE LOWER(TRIM(name)) = LOWER(TRIM('{{ $json.arr_name }}')) LIMIT 1) AS arr_city_id,
  (SELECT atlas_city_id FROM city WHERE LOWER(TRIM(name)) = LOWER(TRIM('{{ $json.arr_name }}')) LIMIT 1) AS arr_atlas_id,

  (
    SELECT COUNT(*) 
    FROM subscription s
    WHERE s.user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM "user" WHERE telegram_id = {{ $json.telegram_id }} LIMIT 1)
      AND LOWER(s.status) = 'active'
  ) AS active_count,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*) 
    FROM subscription s
    WHERE s.user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM "user" WHERE telegram_id = {{ $json.telegram_id }} LIMIT 1)
      AND s.departure_city_id = (SELECT city_id FROM city WHERE LOWER(TRIM(name)) = LOWER(TRIM('{{ $json.dep_name }}')) LIMIT 1)
      AND s.arrival_city_id = (SELECT city_id FROM city WHERE LOWER(TRIM(name)) = LOWER(TRIM('{{ $json.arr_name }}')) LIMIT 1)
      AND s.date = '{{ $json.date }}'::date
      AND s.time_from = '{{ $json.time_from }}'::time
      AND s.time_to = '{{ $json.time_to }}'::time
      AND LOWER(s.status) = 'active'
  ) AS duplicate_count;
